description: Verschluss_DK_KF_04xx is the drawing identifier for enclosure locking component in Hensel's ENYCASE enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An enclosure locking component secures part of the selected access arrangement. Its mechanical mounting must be coordinated with the door, handle and any documented locking sequence.

For example, in an electrical cabinet with controlled maintenance access, use the Verschluss_DK_KF_04xx reference to coordinate lock interface, operating access and door movement. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYCASE_KF_Verschluesse/Verschluss_DK_KF_04xx.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
